title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Can I push to 6:30? I gotta write something I didn’t know I had to
Lemme see if my cousin is going to be home at a normal time to take care of the dog
6:30? Where you at
I’m at the Starbucks across from buddies waiting. Was JUST about to text you
I’m fine going somewhere else besides buddies though
Wtf?
Ok
I’m coming
I didn’t know you were there or I would’ve came
All good man. Buddys still works for you right?
Yeah
Or Miller’s bar
Your call
Food any good at Millers?
Their burgers are notoriously good
Like, sliders but bigger than sliders
Nice. Do I need more than $22 in cash to eat there because if not I’m down to try that
If it doesn’t I’ll make it work. Meet you at Millers
Got a table. Turn left when you enter and head toward the back wall
You just get here?
